name: claim-check
description: Claim checking with zero to many citations per claim: every citation is judged against the whole sentence that carries its marker, with retrieved evidence, exact quotes and explicit abstention (citation-support@2 semantics). Research-integrity tooling for authors, reviewers and study teams (ocsl-review screen).
unit: sentence carrying the citation marker; no carry-over, no clause parsing

k.description: retrieved evidence units per cited work (default 5)

maxEvidenceCharacters.description: evidence window per citation in characters (default 11000)

evidencePolicy.evidence: retrieved window of the cited work's full text

request.api: chat completions on an on-prem judge

evidencePolicy.evidence: the complete abstract when no full text is available

request.api: chat completions on an on-prem judge

requiredModel.served: the judge declared by the screen's egress policy (an on-prem model in confidential mode)

classes: dated retraction, expression of concern and correction status

notes: Every adverse flag reads 'check suggested' until a calibration set measures its positive predictive value.
A screen run records this registry digest and the digest of claim_check.instrument_definition(), whose fields this bundle mirrors (checked by the tests).
